contact_edits.before: There's a difference between the dancing here and that in Oklahoma! that tells as much about the shows themselves and the times that gave birth to them as about these productions. The rambunctious production numbers in Oklahoma! look like hard work, and win our applause for it. The performers (largely the same ones) in My One and Only bewitch us by making it look easy. They look, too, as if they could keep it up forever. I can't recall having as much fun at a Stratford musical. - My One and Only is in repertoire until Oct. 28. Call 1-800-567-1600 or visit www.stratfordfestival.ca for tickets.
